_comment: Verdicts for cases the automated checks mark REVIEW. Assigned by reading the saved output in test-data/outputs/ against the case's stated expectation. Re-done on 21 Nov 2026 after the primary model moved to openai/gpt-oss-120b on Groq; the previous notes described the gemini-3.1-flash-lite run and no longer applied. Failures are recorded, not hidden.

1.note: score 61; TypeScript, REST, responsive CSS and Jest all flagged; 3 rewrites, no invented metric. Weakness: red_flags came back empty although the resume has a generic objective statement

2.note: score 95; only cross-browser testing missing. The 'internship is in the future' hallucination seen on Gemini did not occur

3.note: score 97; hard skills 40/40 and impact 15/15, consistent with a resume full of stated metrics

4.note: score 29; all 7 frontend requirements listed missing; no web experience invented

5.note: score 35; DSA, OOP and Git flagged; no software experience fabricated from a mechanical resume

6.note: hard skills 27/40 but project evidence 0/25; the 30-item skill list is not taken at face value

7.note: score 84 with project evidence 25/25 for a CLI to-do manager and LeetCode practice, and no internship. Over-credits thin projects; expected a mid score

8.note: score 29; Django, DRF, PostgreSQL, Docker, pytest and Celery all flagged. Inconsistency: the same resume scored impact 10/15 in case 1 but 15/15 here

10.note: score 12 with structure 2/10 and no invented projects; the over-scoring of near-empty resumes seen on Gemini is fixed
